name: Thicc of the Woods
source:
Play as Tess Taylor, a 29 year old woman, as she explores the backyard forest of her childhood home, only to discover it leads to the Fairy Realm; a land of mischievous pixies, cackling goblins, and haunting will-o-wisps, all of whom are eager to get closer to Tess, feeding her more and more.

A moment on the lips, an eternity on the lips. Help Tess navigate the Fairy Realm before she gets stuck forever in...the Thicc of the Woods.

[From [url=https://miss-indulgence-games.itch.io/thicc-of-the-woods]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演29岁的女性苔丝·泰勒 (Tess Taylor)，探索儿时家的后院森林，却发现它通向仙境；这片土地上有顽皮的小精灵、咯咯笑的妖精和令人难以忘怀的鬼火，它们都渴望接近苔丝，给她提供越来越多的食物。

唇上的瞬间，唇上的永恒。帮助苔丝在仙境中航行，以免她永远陷入……丛林之中。

[来自[url=https://miss-indulgence-games.itch.io/thicc-of-the-woods]itch.io[/url]]
